messages:
Maya: Heads-up 9:05 1: weekly KPI shows organic webinar signups spiking but demo requests flat. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/metrics/webinar-launch
Ethan: saw that. are those signups coming from paid channels or direct? quick glance looks like a big uplift from partner referral UTMs.
Sofia: I pulled the cohort table. Partner-ref sends +34% signups last 48h but their demo conversion is 0.9% vs baseline 3.2%.
Maya: so quality gap. could be attribution leak (utm overwrite) or registration flow differs by partner. Raj, did the partner embed use the lightbox widget or the native form?
Raj: partner used our embed V2 (lightbox). we rolled a small copy tweak for that embed on Mar 19 to include a prefill param. could that affect required fields or spam checks?
Ethan: possible. also note the tracking pixel version changed in the partner template (v1.4 -> v1.5) which altered how campaign_source is set. we should check mapping upstream.
Sofia: quick SQL sample:

```
SELECT campaign_source, embed_version, count(*) leads, sum(is_demo_request::int) demos
FROM events.registrations
WHERE event_ts > '2026-03-18' AND campaign='q2-launch'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY leads DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Sofia: results: partner_x, embed_v2 -> 2,180 leads, demos 20 (0.9%); organic, native -> 1,120 leads, demos 42 (3.8%).
Maya: big delta. if embed_v2 prefill suppressed optional fields that correlate with demo intent, we lose signal.
Raj: i can diff the form schema between v1/v2. will post the changes. also will check if prefill param replaces utm params in the querystring.
Ethan: let's not jump to rollback yet. proposal: (A) add filter in dashboard to compare embed_version and source (B) tag a sample of partner_x registrations and run a 7-day quality hold (C) reach out to partner engineering to snapshot their template.
Maya: agree. also for weekly KPI review tomorrow, can kpi-bot paste a short delta summary and flag any ingestion anomalies?
kpi-bot: Weekly KPI delta: total signups +14% (7d vs prior 7d); demo requests +1%; demo conversion rate (7d avg) 2.6% (-0.4ppt). No ingestion anomalies detected in last 72h.
Sofia: i'll add the embed_version filter to the launch dashboard and surface a breakdown by country. starting now.
Raj: posted form schema diff: https://repo.redwood/embeds/v2/diff. key diff: prefill param now sets phone_number field and toggles optional->prefilled. also found a bug where utm_source appended as query param "src" instead of "utm_source" for partner_x.
Ethan: that utm rename explains the attribution mismatch. partner X's template rewrites utm keys. we should map "src" -> utm_source in ingestion as a quick fix.
Maya: ok prioritize mapping alias in pipeline for the next deploy. Raj, coordinate with partner to fix template on their side.
Raj: opening PR to patch ingestion mapping, running tests.
Sofia: dashboard updated with embed_version split: see https://dash.redwood/metrics/webinar-launch?embed_version=all
Maya: for KPI review: agenda item  webinar attribution + partner embed experiment. will include action owners: ingestion PR (Ethan), partner follow-up (Raj), dashboard filters (Sofia). Can we also add a backfill check for last 48h to ensure demo counts didn't drop due to mapping?
Ethan: yes adding backfill job to run tonight. will post job ID when queued.
kpi-bot: Action summary added to weekly review: "map src->utm_source alias; run 48h backfill for demo flags; partner template fix". Ticket IDs: MK-5021, MK-5022, MK-5023.
Maya: thanks team. reconvene in tomorrow's KPI sync at 09:00 PT. :calendar:
